WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT bucket_count, bucket_count::numeric / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM bucket_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(bs.bucket_count) AS total_count,
  AVG(bs.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(bs.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM bucket_shares AS bs
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE bs.share > a.avg_share;
